title: Technology package manifest (technology.json)
description: Entry of a technology package: the one file that names a technology's members and the role it plays in an assembly. A carrier package keeps its manifest at libs.tech/adk/technology.json inside its PDK tree, and that directory tree is the package root: every member path is relative to the root, never absolute and never climbing out of it. The manifest names files and states what is not a layer fact; layer facts stay in the routing descriptor, which is a member. Members are grouped in capability sets: A (geometry and assembly), B (automated design) and C (analysis). The schema checks the shape of each member that is present; whether a set is complete is the validator's verdict, which names every missing fact, so a package can pass set A without carrying set B. This version models the carrier role only.

schema_version.description: Governed by docs/VERSION_POLICY.md: a major this reader does not accept is refused.

id.description: Technology id, the key an assembly names the technology by.

roles.description: What the technology can be in an assembly. The die role is reserved for the die half of the package format; this version refuses it as not modelled.

revision.description: Release of the technology this manifest describes, for a carrier the PDK version.

layer_properties.description: Set A. The KLayout layer sheet and its technology file.

routing.description: Sets A and C. The routing tech descriptors (schema interposer_routing_tech, owned by interposer-pnr), one file per variant. Paths inside a descriptor resolve against the package root. Set C reads the resistance slots of every variant, so a variant that cannot be read fails set C as well.

accepted.description: Descriptor versions this package is written for: the given major, at or above the given minor. A descriptor's requires_reader, when it carries one, must name the same major; whether a reader is new enough for it is that reader's own refusal.

stack.description: Set A. The physical stack: substrate, metal z ranges and the attachment plane. The body thickness lives only here. Never an aesthetic (display) stack.

attach.description: Set A. How dies attach to the carrier: methods by id from the interconnect method registry, never their parameters.

external.description: Set A. How the carrier connects outside the assembly. Only wire_bond is modelled; a package naming another method is refused by the schema.

occupied_pairs.description: Set A. The GDS (layer, datatype) pairs the carrier and its decks read, which a die must not reuse when it is composed as-is. Only a measured state passes set A, and a measured state names what measured it.

measured_by.description: The run or test that measured the pairs.

escape_capacity.description: Set A, optional: absent means not measured. How deep a die's signal pillars may sit behind one edge and still escape, one entry per (method, crossing_axis, supply), each measured by the escape capacity command of interposer-pnr. Depth is the number of signal pillars in a line perpendicular to the crossing edge; the planner compares depth, never a pad count.

method.description: One of this package's attach methods.

crossing_axis.description: Preferred direction of the wires that cross the edge: horizontal for an edge at constant x. The layers are the named descriptor's route_layers with that preferred direction.

supply.description: bare: no supply lines or mesh in the array. Another supply arrangement is another key.

pitch_um.description: The pitch the coupon was measured at; equal to the method's pitch.

edge_load_per_mm.description: depth_clean x 1000 / pitch_um, for reading only.

descriptor.description: identity.name of the routing descriptor the coupon was routed with, one of this package's variants.

report_sha256.description: Checked for shape only: a re-run's report carries its own dates and paths.

drc.description: Set B. The carrier DRC entry. The deck tree digest covers deck_folder.

fill.description: Set B. none, or the halo tool; the fill and halo layers are descriptor facts.

seal_ring.description: Set B. none, or the cell that draws the seal ring.

pcells.description: Set B, optional. Without it, the export draws vias and pads as rectangles from the descriptor's rules and says so in its log.

kicad_template.description: Set B. The KiCad board template a carrier design starts from.

em_limits.description: Set C. The electromigration limits file. Set C also needs the resistance slots of every routing layer and via filled in each descriptor variant, and a variant with no routing layer or no via fails it.

layer_name.description: A layer name of the package's layer sheet, without its purpose.

member_path.description: A file relative to the package root, with forward slashes; no absolute path or drive, no '..', no '~', no variables, and no link that leads out of the root.

member_folder.description: A member_path that names a folder rather than a file.
